> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The new per-workflow pin check faithfully mirrors the existing PR-gate policy for local actions, ordinary action/reusable-workflow references, and Docker digests. It fails closed for missing, malformed, and unpinned workflows, is wired into the touched-workflow path before actionlint provisioning, and the self-tests exercise positive, negative, boundary, parser-failure, real-tree parity, and production-wiring cases. I found no correctness, soundness, test-vacuity, or security defect in the diff.
